These forms differ in their biological effects and predictive value, but HER2 mutations, especially exon 20 insertions, are the primary oncogenic mechanism. Regarding diagnosis, Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) is used to identify mutations, whereas Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and in situ hybridization are used to assess HER2 expression.
